description: Java class 'SameProcessServiceHandle' implementing ServiceHandle for services running in the same VM, managing IPCReceiverHandler and JavaEventProducer.

classes.name: SameProcessServiceHandle
classes.description: A ServiceHandle implementation for services in the same process, with methods to get/set IPC and event producers, and identify process locality.

methods.name: SameProcessServiceHandle
methods.description: Constructor initializing with name, ipc, event, and optional visibility.

methods.name: getIpcHandler
methods.description: Returns the IPCReceiverHandler associated with this service handle.

methods.name: setIpcHandler
methods.description: Sets the IPCReceiverHandler for this service handle.

methods.name: getEventProducer
methods.description: Returns the JavaEventProducer associated with this service handle.

methods.name: setEventProducer
methods.description: Sets the JavaEventProducer for this service handle.

methods.name: isSameProcess
methods.description: Indicates that this service runs in the same process (returns true).

methods.name: isLocalHost
methods.description: Indicates that the service is on the local host (returns true).

methods.name: isRemoteHost
methods.description: Indicates that the service is not remote (returns false).
